question: Who has been appointed by the United Nations Development programme (UNDP) as its Goodwill Ambassador in the year 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Lakshmi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Padma Lakshmi was appointed as a Goodwill Ambassador by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) in the year 2019.
 
• She is an internationally renowned author, activist, actress, and model.
 
• Padma Lakshmi has been a strong advocate for women's rights and the fight against hunger and poverty.
 
• As a Goodwill Ambassador, she works to raise awareness and mobilize support for the UNDP's work, including the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **United Nations Development Programme (UNDP)**

 
 
• UNDP is the United Nations' global development network.
 
• It advocates for change and connects countries to knowledge, experience, and resources to help people build a better life.
 
• UNDP operates in nearly 170 countries and territories, working with nations on their own solutions to global and national development challenges.
 
• It focuses on issues such as poverty reduction, HIV/AIDS, democratic governance, energy and environment, and social development.
 
 
 
• **Goodwill Ambassadors**
 
 
• Goodwill Ambassadors are celebrities and public figures appointed by various United Nations agencies to advocate for their causes.
 
• They use their fame and influence to draw attention to important global issues and mobilize support.
 
• Goodwill Ambassadors engage in public advocacy, fundraising, and awareness campaigns.
 
• They often participate in field visits to witness the impact of the UN's work and share their experiences with the public.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**
 
 
• The SDGs are a collection of 17 global goals set by the United Nations General Assembly in 2015.
 
• They are designed to be a "blueprint to achieve a better and more sustainable future for all" by 2030.
 
• The SDGs address global challenges, including poverty, inequality, climate change, environmental degradation, peace, and justice.
 
• Each goal has specific targets to be achieved, and progress is monitored through a set of indicators.
